name: state-machine
title: State machines
description: State diagrams drawn from a small JSON spec, and a simulator that steps a machine through an input string (deterministic or not, with ε moves).

classPrefix.description: Prefix of the classes on hosts (<prefix>sim, <prefix>figure) and on generated elements (<prefix>state, <prefix>edge, …), for page CSS and scripts. Change it to keep an existing site's class names.

labelColor.description: Colour of edge labels: a CSS colour or a core token name; empty = the accent colour.

startLabel.description: Text by the arrow into the start state; empty = none.

tapeLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of input symbols.

runLabel.description: Read the rest of the input.

currentState.description: Status for a deterministic machine; {state} is its label.

noTransition.description: Status when a deterministic machine has no move.

currentStates.description: Status for a nondeterministic machine; {states} lists the labels (the doubled braces print as set braces).

noStatesLeft.description: Added when a nondeterministic machine has no states left.

acceptLabel.description: Verdict when the whole input is read and the machine accepts.

notInAlphabet.description: Verdict when the input has a symbol the machine does not read.

readsOnly.description: Explains the alphabet; {alphabet} lists its symbols.

machineName.description: Switch-button text for an unnamed machine in a multi-machine simulator.
